Books

I wasn't a reader growing up, but research and investing taught me the fastest way to learn is by consuming high-quality content. Reading is the source of truth and is less biased than videos. I keep a list of books I've read and want to read.

Reading helps me learn with fewer distractions. I track both finished books and a growing list to read.
